title: Not enough credits
explanation: Your workspace credit balance is too low to complete this generation. Each generation reserves credits before it starts.
remediation: Top up your wallet via Settings → Billing, or ask your workspace admin to add credits.

title: Studio not configured
explanation: The AI model for this studio isn't enabled yet on your platform.
remediation: Contact the Aiwa team or platform administrator to enable the required model.

title: Provider error
explanation: The AI provider (Groq, BytePlus, or NVIDIA) returned an error or is temporarily unavailable.
remediation: Wait a few moments and try again. If the error persists, use the support button to escalate to the dev team.

title: Generation timed out
explanation: The generation took longer than expected and timed out. Your credits were automatically released or refunded.
remediation: Check the generation log. If the job failed, you can safely retry.

title: Job under manual review
explanation: This generation was flagged for manual review by the platform. It has not failed — our team will inspect it shortly.
remediation: Please do not resubmit the request. Wait for the review to settle, or contact developer support.

title: Upload failed
explanation: Your file could not be uploaded. This is usually caused by file size, format mismatch, or a temporary network glitch.
remediation: Check that your file is within limits (5 MB for image portraits, 25 MB for audio) and is a supported MIME type (JPEG/PNG, MP3/WAV).
